name: Windows — Volume Shadow Copy / Backup Deletion (Ransomware Impact)
description: Detects deletion of Volume Shadow Copies or backups and disabling of recovery — via vssadmin, wbadmin, wmic shadowcopy, bcdedit or diskshadow. This is a near-universal ransomware pre-encryption step to prevent recovery.
note:
## Coverage
Depends on process.command_line, populated on ~29% of Windows hosts today; coverage expands after the process-command-line auditing GPO.
## Investigation
1. `SubjectUserName` on `host.name` ran `process.command_line`.
2. Legitimate backup software rarely deletes ALL shadows with ignore-failures flags.
## Response
Treat as active ransomware: isolate the host immediately, identify the parent process, and begin IR.
author: raadabujaish
query: event.code:"4688" and process.name:("vssadmin.exe" or "wbadmin.exe" or "wmic.exe" or "bcdedit.exe" or "diskshadow.exe") and process.command_line:(*delete* or *shadowcopy* or *shadows* or *recoveryenabled* or *ignoreallfailures*)
